title: Burgundy Wedding Train Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Trailing Burgundy Foliage
description:
Transform your containers with this vibrant, trailing coleus!
KEY FEATURES
• Distinctive trailing habit, ideal for baskets and containers
• Striking burgundy foliage with lime green edges
• Thrives in both sun and shade conditions
• Heat tolerant and hardy until frost
• Low maintenance and easy to grow
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'Kakegawa CE10'
Colour: Burgundy and lime green foliage
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Trailing
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial Sun to Full Shade
Soil: Well-drained soil
Watering: Average to heavy watering; keep soil consistently moist
Spacing: 61-91 cm (24-36 inches)
Height: 25-30 cm (10-12 inches)
Spread: 61-91 cm (24-36 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 9 (typically grown as an annual in the UK)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in well-drained soil and ensure consistent moisture.
• Pinch off flower spikes as they appear to encourage bushier foliage.
• Fertilise every two weeks during the growing season for optimal health.
• Protect from frost; treat as an annual in colder climates or bring indoors.
• Avoid excessive stem elongation by transplanting on time and managing light levels.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
